Omega-3 fatty acids are essential nutrients that support several functions in the body. They contribute to heart and brain health, help maintain healthy vision and may help reduce inflammation associated with certain joint conditions. Including omega-3-rich foods in your daily diet is a simple way to improve your nutritional intake.
In this video, Hansaji explains the benefits of omega-3 and how to include plant-based sources in everyday Indian meals.
You will learn about:
1. How omega-3 fatty acids support heart health and help manage triglyceride levels.
